records.source: Wow, a birthday present! I love it!$h
records.translation: Wow, regalo sa kaarawan! Gustong-gusto ko!$h

records.source: I'm scared...$s
records.translation: Natatakot ako...$s

records.source: I hope the rain doesn't turn my dress green...$s
records.translation: Sana hindi gawing berde ng ulan ang bestida ko...$s

records.source: A birthday present? Oh... I don't like this.$s
records.translation: Regalo sa kaarawan? Ah... Ayaw ko nito.$s

records.source: Are you sure? It smells so good! I'll only drink a thimbleful a day.$h
records.translation: Tiyak ka ba? Napakabango! Isang didal na puno lang ang iinumin ko bawat araw.$h

records.source: Wow, it's so pretty! And there's a fairy inside? *giggle*... I can hear her singing. She'll be my secret friend.$h
records.translation: Wow, napakaganda! At may diwata sa loob? *hagikgik*... Naririnig ko siyang kumakanta. Magiging lihim ko siyang kaibigan.$h

records.source: Oh, a little dolly! She's kind of dirty, but I'll give her a bath. Thanks!$h
records.translation: Ah, munting manika! Medyo marumi siya, pero paliliguan ko siya. Salamat!$h

records.source: Oh, I like him! He'll fit right in with my other friends.$h
records.translation: Ah, gusto ko siya! Babagay siya sa iba ko pang kaibigan.$h

records.source: Umm... I'm not supposed to drink this. Isn't it for adults?$s
records.translation: Umm... Hindi ako dapat umiinom nito. Hindi ba para ito sa matatanda?$s

records.source: Oh... Aunt Marnie doesn't let me drink coffee yet...$s
records.translation: Ah... Hindi pa ako pinapayagan ni Tita Marnie na uminom ng kape...$s

records.source: I see a crab!
records.translation: May nakikita akong alimango!

records.source: I've got sand in my shoe...$s
records.translation: May buhangin sa sapatos ko...$s

records.source: I'm collecting seashells... I'm gonna make a necklace!
records.translation: Nangongolekta ako ng mga kabibe... Gagawa ako ng kuwintas!

records.source: Aunt Marnie told me not to get burnt... But when I walk fast, it feels cool, so I think I'll be okay.$h
records.translation: Sinabi ni Tita Marnie na huwag akong masunog sa araw... Pero kapag mabilis akong naglalakad, malamig ang pakiramdam, kaya sa tingin ko ay ayos lang ako.$h

records.source: Aunt Marnie says I'm not old enough to see a movie by myself...$s
records.translation: Sabi ni Tita Marnie, hindi pa sapat ang edad ko para manood ng pelikula nang mag-isa...$s

records.source: Ew, gross!$s
records.translation: Ew, nakakadiri!$s

records.source: I hope Shane will still come and see me...$s
records.translation: Sana dadalawin pa rin ako ni Shane...$s

records.source: *sigh*... I hope I can get married some day.$u
records.translation: *buntong-hininga*... Sana makapag-asawa rin ako balang araw.$u

records.source: $y 'Um... Have you ever seen a fairy?_Yes_Wow! I wanna see one, too.$h_No_...Me neither.$s'
records.translation: $y 'Um... Nakakita ka na ba ng diwata?_Oo_Wow! Gusto ko ring makakita.$h_Hindi_...Ako rin, hindi pa.$s'

records.source: ...Is Shane going to be okay?$s
records.translation: ...Magiging maayos ba si Shane?$s

records.source: I had a nightmare that the house was on fire...$s
records.translation: Nanaginip ako ng masama na nasusunog ang bahay...$s

records.source: *giggle* ...look, I've got real bunny-jewel slippers!$h
records.translation: *hagikgik*... tingnan mo, may tunay akong tsinelas na may hiyas na kuneho!$h

records.source: Oh...Are you looking for Aunt Marnie?$u
records.translation: Ah... Hinahanap mo ba si Tita Marnie?$u

records.source: Hi, Mr. @.^Hi, Ms. @.#$e#It's fun to live on a farm.$h
records.translation: Kumusta, Ginoong @.^Kumusta, Binibining @.#$e#Masayang tumira sa bukid.$h

records.source: What? *giggle*$h#$e#...hi.
records.translation: Ano? *hagikgik*$h#$e#...kumusta.

records.source: You can play with my dolls if you want to. Just make sure to brush their hair when you're done.
records.translation: Maaari mong paglaruan ang mga manika ko kung gusto mo. Tiyakin mo lang na suklayin ang buhok nila kapag tapos ka na.

records.preserveReason: Intentional silent ellipsis plus control token; it contains no translatable lexical content.

records.translation: ...Kumusta.$u

records.source: Aunt Marnie won't let me go out after 6 o'clock. It's not fair!$s#$e#I'm not afraid of the dark anymore!
records.translation: Hindi ako pinapayagan ni Tita Marnie na lumabas pagkalipas ng alas-sais. Hindi iyon makatarungan!$s#$e#Hindi na ako natatakot sa dilim!

records.source: I'm not supposed to talk to strangers...$u
records.translation: Hindi ako dapat nakikipag-usap sa mga estranghero...$u

records.source: Miss Penny is teaching me how to write in cursive.$h#$e#She has such pretty handwriting.
records.translation: Tinuturuan ako ni Binibining Penny kung paano sumulat nang dugtung-dugtong.$h#$e#Napakaganda ng sulat-kamay niya.

records.source: ... I don't know you.$u
records.translation: ... Hindi kita kilala.$u

records.source: Do you like my bow?
records.translation: Gusto mo ba ang laso ko?

records.source: I like living on the farm... my favorite is the fresh ice cream from our cows' milk.
records.translation: Gusto kong tumira sa bukid... Paborito ko ang sariwang sorbetes mula sa gatas ng mga baka namin.

records.source: You smell like grass.$u
records.translation: Amoy-damo ka.$u

records.source: Sometimes I look for crawdads in the river. Don't tell Aunt Marnie... but I fed one to a cow once.#$e#She loved it.
records.translation: Minsan ay naghahanap ako ng ulang sa ilog. Huwag mong sabihin kay Tita Marnie... pero minsan ay pinakain ko sa baka ang isa.#$e#Gustong-gusto niya iyon.

records.source: You're always so nice to me, ${Mr.^Ms.}$ @.$h#$e#Grown-ups are usually mean and boring, but you're different.
records.translation: Palagi kang napakabait sa akin, ${G.^Bb.}$ @.$h#$e#Karaniwang masasama at nakakabagot ang mga nakatatanda, pero naiiba ka.

records.source: Um... d...do you want something?$u#$e#I'm not supposed to talk to strangers.$u
records.translation: Um... m...may gusto ka ba?$u#$e#Hindi ako dapat nakikipag-usap sa mga estranghero.$u

records.source: Shane's gone a lot, and Aunt Marnie is busy all the time... so I have to invent my own games.#$e#I'm thankful for all my toys.$h
records.translation: Madalas wala si Shane at palaging abala si Tita Marnie... kaya kailangan kong gumawa ng sarili kong mga laro.#$e#Nagpapasalamat ako sa lahat ng laruan ko.$h

records.source: Did you know Shane's my godfather? He was a friend of my parents.$s#$e#...they died. *sniff*$s
records.translation: Alam mo bang ninong ko si Shane? Kaibigan siya ng mga magulang ko.$s#$e#...namatay sila. *singhot*$s
